allReviewedPassages.rawText: The Important finding was verified: the old pre-loop extraction executed operational Resume with a null-returning agent and passed selected Launch invocationId only for review-output kinds. The fix returns the existing real builders after declaration/state initialization and before operational Resume. lastPlanned moved before that boundary because implementPrompt reads it. Complete coordinator source remains available for hoisted function declarations. No public startup argument, synthetic identity/acknowledgment, minted rendering token, replacement engine or new dispatch was added. A throwing operational adapter catches any accidental loader dispatch. All kinds receive a safe identity from the selected last Launch unchanged when present; legacy non-review rendering leaves identity unresolved. Strict .29 review identity/equality/source-binding gates and write guards are untouched, as is strict live missing/unsafe-ID failure and awaited Launch persistence.
